primaryGoal: Witness AI development through 99 playable browser-game experiments.
notTheGoal: This is not a rushed attempt to mass-produce 99 AI-made games.
archiveMethod: Playable game experiments with provenance, model variants, run records, and curator notes.
mission: A long-term AI game-making evolution archive where playable browser games act as observation samples.
maintainerRole: The maintainer curates prompts, tests builds, publishes games, and documents provenance without hand-editing game code.

slotVariantRunPolicy.summary: The 99 game slots represent 99 observation samples, not 99 AI generations.
slotVariantRunPolicy.gameSlot: One official playable experiment in the AI evolution archive.
slotVariantRunPolicy.modelVariant: A version of the same game concept made by a specific model or agent. Variants do not consume additional game numbers.
slotVariantRunPolicy.runRecord: One generation, revision, validation, or comparison attempt for a game or variant. Run records can grow indefinitely.

games.title: Signal Cartographer
games.description: A tactical canvas survival game about mapping a hostile signal field before interference erases your route.

deviceSupport.mobileNotes: Mobile play mode includes a virtual joystick, beacon, pause, and restart controls near the canvas. Verified in local browser mobile viewports; no physical handset claim is made.

provenance.notes: Model label is maintainer-declared for this project entry. Code, launcher updates, and documentation were generated by Codex under the no-human-code-edits project rule.

games.repositoryNote: Observation 001 / Game 001. First playable evidence sample in the AI game-making evolution archive.

games.title: Lumen Lattice
games.archiveRole: First Puzzle Logic Hall observation sample
games.description: A constraint logic puzzle where pressing a node flips its whole row and column. Every lattice is generated by scrambling a solved board, so it is guaranteed solvable.

deviceSupport.mobileNotes: Tap-first play is supported with a square canvas and compact Hint, Undo, and Reset toolbar near the lattice. Verified in local browser mobile viewports; no physical handset claim is made.

provenance.notes: Model label is maintainer-declared for this project entry. Game code and the solving-aware hint system were generated by Claude Code under the no-human-code-edits project rule.

games.repositoryNote: Observation 002 / Game 002. First Puzzle Logic Hall sample, contributed as evidence of what Claude Opus 4.8 could design and implement.
